rationale: The agent identified the user and pulled relevant orders, but then performed order-changing writes (address change and item exchange) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. Additionally, the final message confirms only the Bluetooth speaker exchange and refund, omitting any confirmation or outcome about the shipping address change. While actions appear to target the correct order and use the user's payment method, the lack of confirmation and incomplete final information mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
